     Wild Indigo. Leguminosæ.

     An old Indian drug, first used by the Eclectics until introduced into our School by N. L. Thompson, in 1857. The first useful proving was given by J. S. Douglas and others, followed by Hadley, Burt, Harpel and Schenck, in 1871 ; by Wallace, in 1873 ; C. Wesselhœft, in 1875. The most important symptoms from practice have been given us by Dr. J. B. Bell.

   

MIND. [1] [Bapt.]
Unconsciousness. θ Typhus.
Stupor ; falls asleep while being spoken to, or answering ; heavy sleep until aroused ; awakes only to again fall asleep in the midst of his answer, which he vainly endeavors to finish. θ Typhus.
Confusion of ideas ; confused as if drunk.
Cannot confine his mind ; a sort of wild, wandering feeling.
Cannot go to sleep, because he cannot get himself together. θ Orchitis. θ Typhoid.
Sensation as if there was a second self outside of patient. θ Typhus.
Feels scattered about, and tosses about to get the pieces together. θ Typhus.
He thinks his gouty legs are holding a conversation with each other ; a man, æt. 60. θ Gout.
He thinks his toe is holding a confab with his gouty thumb.
Mind wanders as soon as the eyes are closed.
Delirium, especially at night, or constant, low ; stupor. θ Typhus.
Delirium and incoherent talk. θ Typhus.
Delirious stupor or fierce delirium. θ Typhus.
Low muttering. θ Typhus.
Indisposed to think, want of power ; mind seems weak.
Aversion to mental or bodily exertion, or to hear conversation about sickness or injuries ; feeble mind ; fretful. θ Spasmodic stricture of œsophagus.
A sensation as if some person touched him gently while dozing. See 37.
Perfect indifference, does not care to do anything ; inability to fix the mind on anything.
Hopeless of recovery, and certain of death. θ Typhus.
Mentally restless, but too lifeless to move.
Restless and delirious for three weeks. θ Typhus.
Want of mental force. θ Typhus.
Worse when thinking of pains in various parts of body.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Bapt.]
Vertigo and weak feeling of entire system, especially of lower limbs and knees.
Dizzy when stooping.
Vertigo with paralysis of eyelids.
Giddiness and severe nausea. θ Typhus.
Head feels heavy, as if he could not sit up.
Dull, heavy sensation in head with drowsiness ; unfit for mental labor.
Frequent fainting ; tongue dry, brown, in morning.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Bapt.]
Peculiar feeling in head, which is never felt except during fever, excitement of brain, such as precedes delirium.
Head feels heavy as if he could not sit up, day and night, causing a wild feeling ; < from noise.
Dull, stupefying headache with fulness ; sensation as if a band were around forehead ; confusion of ideas ; stupor ; dull, heavy looking eyes, besotted expression ; feel as if had been drunk and was just recovering from its effects ; general debility and nervous prostration.
Head feels large and heavy, with numb feeling of head and face ; stitches or shocks in various parts of head.
Dull, heavy, pressive headache.
A dull, heavy feeling in head, especially forehead and malar bones ; ears feel hot, yet cold to touch ; head feels swollen ; giddiness, as if he had taken liquor, < when walking.
Dull, heavy feeling in head with general languor ; eyes pain while reading by gaslight ; 2d day.
Dull, heavy, full feeling in forehead with slight frontal headache, with sensation as if temples were pressed by thumbs ; 1st day.
Pain in forehead over left eye in region of supraorbital foramen ; darts of pain in different parts of body ; 2d day.
Slight frontal headache after having been up awhile ; forehead hot ; 4th day.
Frontal headache, weighty. θ Typhus.
Dull, heavy headache, > from pressure on nasal bones and < from mental labor.
Fulness of head, with fluctuation when walking.
Frontal headache : with pressure at root of nose ; with feeling of fulness and tightness of whole head.
Pressive pain in forehead as if it would be pressed in, with sharp pains in both temples ; much < from motion.
Sharp darts of pain in supraorbital nerve at foramen.
Dull pain in anterior lobes of brain and right frontal sinus ; afternoon.
Severe pain passing from insertion of right sterno-mastoid muscle through head into orbit, causing a dull, heavy feeling in head, especially forehead, > by pressing below mastoid process.
Beating headache in forehead, with soreness in back of head, immediately below occipital protuberance, followed by hot stitches in temples.
Frequent pain in right temple ; sharp pain by spells in both.
Heavy pain at base of brain, with lameness and drawing in cervical muscles.
Fulness in head with pain behind right ear ; > having lain quiet for a short time.
Headache and pain behind right ear, > after dinner.
Severe pain in occiput with dull, stupid feeling all over head ; sharp pain over eyes.
Dull feeling in occiput, with pain and fulness of vessels.
Throbbing in head, over eyes, with weakness in limbs on going up-stairs.
Dull bruised ache in head. θ Typhus.
Dull, bruised feeling in occiput. θ Diphtheria.
Soreness as if in brain, frontal region, with pain, heat, vertigo ; < on stooping.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Bapt.]
Top of head feels as if it would fly off.
Great tightness of forehead.
Scalp feels sore.
Sensation as if head was swelling (slowly growing larger and larger), with pain at insertion of sterno-cleido-mastoid muscle accompanied by a sensation as if head was swollen behind ear, right side.
Dull, bruised ache in head. θ Typhus.
Several sharp thrusts of pain in head over right eye.
Fulness of external vessels of head and face.
Neck feels so tired, she can't hold her head easy in any position.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Bapt.]
Cannot bear light ; eyes burn, but do not water. θ Chronic sore eyes.
Eyes weak.
Occasionally delirium with confusion of sight. θ Diphtheria.
Feeling as if eyes would be pressed into head ; eyeballs feel sore with great confusion of sight ; cannot place anything, until after looking at it a few seconds ; everything appears to move.
Severe pain in eyes while reading, compelled to stop.
Severe pain in left eye, < from pressing on crown of head, with dull headache.
Eyes dull. θ Typhus.
Left eye for a moment feels very weak, followed by stitches in upper eyelid.
Stitches in right eye ; also in left as from needles.
Sharp pain over right eye, then over left.
Weight over eyes. θ Typhus.
Bloated feeling of eyes, glistening ; disposition to have them half closed.
Eyes feel swollen, slight lachrymation with burning.
Eyeballs feel sore ; sore and lame on moving them.
Soreness in front of head when moving eyes or turning them upward.
Vessels congested, eyes look red, inflamed.
Eyes still injected with burning pain in them, causing running of right nostril ; < from reading and from light of candle.
Eyes in morning still injected and pain, and contain thick, yellow pus, which cause them to burn ; < while reading.
Chronic sore eyes.
Partial paralysis of lids ; difficulty in keeping them open.
Pain in region of supraorbital nerve, > from pressure.
Pain in orbital plate of superior maxillary bone (left eye), relieved by pressure.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Bapt.]
Dull hearing. θ Typhus.
Roaring in ears with mental confusion.
Delirium with almost complete deafness. θ Diphtheria.
Ears feel hot and burn, yet cold to touch.
Right ear sore and neck tired.
Soreness in right ear, running down neck.
Pain below left ear, midway between mastoid process and angle of lower jaw.
Slight pain in left parotid gland.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Bapt.]
Soreness extends to posterior nares.
Severe drawing pains along nose.
Right nostril stopped up.
Nose stopped up as if had taken a bad cold ; when sneezing and blowing nose, slight bleeding from left nostril of bright red blood (thick) ; 2d day.
Thick mucus from nose.
Dull pain at root of nose. θ Catarrh.
Sneezing and feeling as after taking cold.
Crampy sensation at root of nose.
Unpleasant sensation at root of nose (especially left), as if water had passed through posterior nares while drinking.
Epistaxis and oozing of dark blood from nose for two or three days. θ Typhus.
Sensation of great fulness, œdematous swelling of affected parts, especially in choanæ. θ Diphtheria.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Bapt.]
Looked ill for two weeks. θ Typhus.
Anxious, frightened look. θ Cough.
Yellowish cheeks ; central deep flush. θ Typhus.
Face : sallow ; dark red, with besotted expression ; flushed, dusky ; hot and perceptibly flushed.
Burning, prickling of left side of face and head.
Burning heat in face with flushed cheeks. θ Diphtheria.
Cheeks burn.
Cheeks flushed, dark violet. θ Cough.
Heat all over, most in face. θ Typhus.
Critical sweat on forehead and face. θ Typhus.
Face and whole head feel numb.
Muscles of jaw rigid.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Bapt.]
Pain in articulation of lower jaw. θ Typhus.
Jaw dropped. θ Typhus.
Cracked lips, with bleeding and ulceration of bowels. θ Typhus.
Pain in region of right mastoid process.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Bapt.]
Teeth and gums sore ; by pressing with finger large quantities of blood ooze out.
Sordes on teeth and lips ; tongue ulcerated. θ Typhus.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Bapt.]
Taste : flat, bitter, sometimes putrid.
Filthy taste with flow of saliva.
Foul or bitter nauseous taste in mouth. θ Typhus.
Tongue swollen, thick, making talking difficult.
Slight heat or burning at root of tongue.
Tongue red and dry in middle. θ Typhus.
Tongue feels dry on rubbing against roof of mouth ; smarts, feels burned.
The roof of tongue is swollen and feels numb. θ Diphtheria.
Tongue of a dark hue. θ Cough.
Dry, parched, thickly coated tongue. θ Typhus.
Tongue dry, brown down centre. θ Typhus.
Tongue covered with a thick, brown crust. θ Typhus.
Tongue baked down centre. θ Typhus.
Tongue at first white with red papillæ here and there, followed by a yellow-brown coating in centre, edges being red, shining.
Tongue coated white, yellow or yellowish-brown, and feels as if burned or scalded. θ Diphtheria.
Tongue yellowish-white, deeply furred. θ Typhus.
Tongue has a yellow centre, or yellowish-brown coating, dry. θ Typhus.
Foul tongue. θ Typhus.
Tongue feels as though it had been scraped, and sensation extending to fauces.
Tongue cracked down centre.
Cracked, sore, ulcerated tongue. θ Typhus.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Bapt.]
Stomatitis materna ; breath fetid ; feeble state.
Fetid odor ; also after mercury.
Mouth and tongue very dry. θ In fevers.
Filthy taste, with flow of saliva.
Saliva rather abundant, somewhat viscid, tasting flat.
Copious saliva : followed by sore throat, scraping, burning ; slight pain in right lung.
Copious flow of saliva ; ulcers in mouth.
Cancrum oris, copious saliva ; gums loose, flabby, dark red, or purple ; fetid.
Aphthæ. θ Typhus.
Sore mouth of sucklings and consumptives.
Canker sores in mouth.
Ulcerations extending from mouth, through alimentary canal, with watery discharges from bowels.
Putrid ulceration of buccal cavity, with salivation ; well-developed ulcers, slight pain.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Bapt.]
Pain and soreness of fauces. θ Diphtheria.
Hot feeling in fauces, passing up into ears ; sensation as if had eaten pepper.
Fauces dark red ; dark, putrid ulcers ; tonsils and parotids swollen ; unusual absence of pain. θ Diphtheria. θ Putrid sore throat, etc. θ Typhus. θ Variola.
Scraping and burning, raw sensation in pharynx ; much viscid mucus ; copious flow of saliva ; ulcers in mouth.
Dry scraping in throat when swallowing ; tongue coated white, especially at root ; fetid perspiration of body, and especially hands ; eyes much injected ; face and ears hot and very red ; absence of thirst ; heaviness in chest, with dull pain in region of spleen.
Burning and heat in fauces, as from heartburn, extending into ears ; < from belching, which causes pain to extend into chest, and there producing a weak feeling.
Tonsils and soft palate swollen, with constant inclination to swallow, not accompanied by pain. θ Diphtheria.
Stitches in right tonsil.
Tonsils and soft palate very red, but not painful.
Pricking in upper part of pharynx ; raw sensation.
Tickling in throat provoking cough ; uvula elongated.
Sore throat.
Throat sore ; averse to open air.
Mucus abundant and viscid, can neither be swallowed nor expectorated.
Mucus rattles in throat. θ Typhus.
Œsophagus feels as if constricted from above down to stomach ; can only swallow water.
Constrictive feeling causing frequent efforts at deglutition ; throat sore, feels contracted.
Throat feels swollen, full ; tonsils and soft palate congested ; frequent inclination to swallow, causing pain in root of tongue.
Spits out liquids put in mouth. θ Typhus.
Can swallow liquids only ; least solid food gags. θ Spasmodic stricture of œsophagus. θ Diarrhœa.
Children cannot swallow solid food ; the smallest solid substance causes gagging, thus they cannot use anything but milk ; sometimes thin, watery, offensive passages day and night. (Compare Silicea).
Unable to swallow. θ Typhus.
Paralysis of organs of deglutition. θ Typhus.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Bapt.]
Loss of appetite. θ Typhus.
Constant desire for water, with nausea and want of appetite. θ Typhus.
Spitting out of liquids put into her mouth.
Great thirst. θ Typhus.
A good deal of thirst. θ Typhus.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Bapt.]
All symptoms < from beer.
After breakfast, dull feeling.
Hiccough, Belching, Nausea and Vomiting
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Bapt.]
Nausea, with inclination to vomit, relieved for a short time by eructations.
Feels as if she wants to raise a great deal.
Pressure at stomach, belching of large quantities of wind.
Nausea with eructations, followed by painful vomiting.
Feeling as if he would vomit, but no nausea, with severe shooting in left kidney and to left of umbilicus.
Retching and vomiting. θ Typhoid fever.
Feeling as if it would be a relief to vomit.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Bapt.]
At night frequent pain in epigastric region ; < from turning over, which he had to do all the time.
Full feeling in stomach.
Heavy gnawing in stomach ; 3d day.
Burning heat in stomach rising up towards throat ; 2d day.
Sinking, "gone" feeling at stomach, fainting ; tongue brown in morning. θ Dyspepsia after typhus.
Constant burning distress in epigastrium, severe colicky pains in umbilical, and especially hypogastric region ; rumbling in bowels ; desire to vomit, but without nausea.
Cramp in stomach ; evening.
Severe pain every few minutes in cardiac region of stomach.
Sinking feeling in stomach, with shoulder pains.
Sinking sensation in stomach. θ Typhus.
Pains in stomach ; feeling there as of a hard substance.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Bapt.]
Sensation of weight and oppression in precordial region, with a feeling of unsatisfied breathing ; afternoon.
Dull pain at pit of stomach, with constriction of diaphragm.
Constant pain in stomach and liver ; < walking ; hot sensation ; heavy aching in stomach and liver.
Pain in region of liver on going up-stairs.
Pain in liver, from right lateral ligament to gall-bladder ; can scarcely walk, it so augments pain in gall-bladder.
Must stir about, yet motion is painful ; pain over gall-bladder.
Constant aching distress in stomach and umbilical region, with a great deal of pain in region of gall-bladder ; pain extends to spine.
Pain in region of spleen, with darts of pain in body, especially in carpus, metacarpus and phalanges ; 2d day.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Bapt.]
Severe colicky pains in umbilical and hypochondriac regions, recurring every few seconds ; rumbling desire for stool.
Pain in abdomen with diarrhœa. θ Typhus.
Griping pain in bowels while at stool.
Distress, dull pain in umbilical region.
Distended abdomen ; fulness ; flatulence, rumbling, feels as if vomiting would relieve ; mushy stools.
Sharp, shooting pains in bowels, with constant pain in hypochondriac region.
Dull aching, distress in bowels.
Right iliac region sensitive. θ Typhus.
Abdominal muscles sore on pressure, with acute intermitting pain. θ Typhus.
Abdominal tenderness, with flatulency ; 10th day. θ Typhus.
Cutting in bowels, relieved for a short time by passage of flatus, which causes burning at anus.
Pain in abdomen on pressure, with dull aching in lumbar region on going to bed.
Sharp rheumatic stitches in right groin, lasting but a little while, but after a short interval returning as before.
Severe pain in left groin ; < from walking, > from rest, but returning again on motion.
Glands of left groin swollen ; painful on walking.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Bapt.]
Diarrhœa, with pain and soreness in bowels. θ Typhus.
Soft, papescent stool, with large quantities of mucus.
Stools of pure blood, or bloody mucus.
Fetid, exhausting diarrhœa, causing excoriation.
Thin, watery, offensive diarrhœa day and night ; child can swallow nothing but milk ; smallest quantity of solid food gags.
Aphthous diarrhœa.
Involuntary diarrhœa ; 9th to 11th day. θ Typhus.
Evacuation light yellow or brown, thin and watery. θ Typhus.
Stools soft, papescent, with large quantities of mucus.
Dark brown mucous and bloody stools, with typhoid tendency ; brown tongue, etc.
Stools : dark, thin, fecal, offensive.
Fetid stools. θ Typhus.
Dysentery : rigors, pains in limbs and small of back ; stools small, all blood, not very dark, but thick ; great tenesmus ; great prostration, brown tongue, low fever ; in the Autumn, or in hot weather.
Colicky pains before stool. θ Dysentery in old people.
Stool very small and difficult to pass, it resembles sheep dung ; pain in bowels after stool ; 2d day.
Constipation ; stool very small, passed only by very great straining and urging ; 3d day.
Stool like sheep dung, dry and crumbling ; pain before stool, weakness after stool.
Constipation and diarrhœa ; stools dark and bloodstreaked. θ Diphtheria.
Before stool : severe colic, more in hypogastrium.
During stool : tenesmus ; colic.
After stool : tenesmus ; relief of colic.
Constipation ; hemorrhoids in afternoon.
Stricture from piles.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Bapt.]
Stitches in region of right kidney.
Shooting pains in region of left kidney.
Urine scanty, dark red ; light green.
Burning when urinating.
Urine very highly colored and scanty. θ Typhus.
Urine alkaline, fetid. θ Typhus.
Passes water often with a great deal of fiery pain, water is clear, scum on it in variegated colors ; red sand is passed with urine, and is seen at once on bottom of vessel.
Increased secretion of urine at night.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Bapt.]
Dull drawing in right groin and testicle, also in legs and knee joints.
Orchitis ; cannot sleep because he feels as if his body was scattered about bed.
Pressing pain in left testicle, as if it had been squeezed, lasting but a short time.
Cramps in testes, as if they had been squeezed.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Bapt.]
Menses too early and too profuse.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Bapt.]
Excites abortion.
Threatened abortion. θ Typhus.
Lochia acrid, fetid ; great prostration.
Puerperal fever, with typhoid symptoms.
Stomatitis materna.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Bapt.]
Hoarseness or aphonia.
Aphonia. θ Diphtheria.
Larynx very sore to touch, painful swallowing or speaking.
Hoarseness, must use great effort to be understood.
Swelling of epiglottis, mornings.
Increased secretion from bronchial tubes and fauces, with expectoration of mucus.
As if she wanted to raise a great deal.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Bapt.]
Fetid breath. θ Typhus.
Asthmatic oppression of chest, with frequent yawning ; < from motion ; > after rest.
Snoring respiration.
Oppressed breathing, 6 P. M., with cough ; right lung sore ; sneezing.
Awoke with great difficulty of breathing ; lungs felt tight, compressed ; could not get a full breath ; must open window and get his face to fresh air ; burning heat of skin ; dry tongue ; accelerated pulse ; peculiar feeling of brain.
On lying down difficult breathing, but no constriction of chest, must rise ; afraid to go to sleep, fears nightmare and suffocation ; arises from want of power in lungs, not constriction.
Dyspnœa, with a tight cough.
Stitches in sternum on inhalation.
   

COUGH. [27] [Bapt.]
Tickling in throat provoking cough ; uvula elongated.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Bapt.]
Tightness of chest ; constriction.
Pain in right lung ; less pain in left, with soreness.
Pain through left chest.
Sharp pains when taking a long breath.
Dull, oppressive pain in left chest at origin of serratus magnus ; < on inspiration and motion ; pains in metacarpal bones.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Bapt.]
Throbbing of heart so as to be distinctly heard.
Compass and frequency of heart's pulsations seem increased ; pulsations seem to fill chest.
Pulse at first accelerated, afterwards slow and faint.
Pulse 70 ; rises about 2 P. M. to 100.
Pulse 100-125, hard in evening. θ Typhus.
Pulse slow, round, full.
Pulse 110, variable, weak, thready. θ Typhus.
Pulse slow and weak.
Pulse small and quickened. θ Typhus.
Pulse 100 and feeble. θ Typhus.
Pulse 120 and thready.
Pulse 120, small and weak. θ Cough.
Pulse accelerated or slower than in health. θ Diphtheria.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Bapt.]
Sharp pain in centre of sternum.
Dull stitches in left nipple.
Dull heavy pains in region of origin of pectoralis minor, lasting about ten minutes, followed by a bruised feeling.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Bapt.]
Neck so tired she cannot hold her head easy in any position ; sore down neck.
Cervical muscles stiff, lame.
Pain under right scapula ; better on motion.
Back and hips very stiff, ache severely.
Catarrhal pneumonia ; elevated temperature ; pulse over a hundred, even with excessive cough and hemorrhages ; cavities ; night sweat and diarrhœa (relieves greatly).
Dull lumbar backache, worse walking.
Dull sacral pain, compounded of a feeling as from pressure and fatigue, from long stooping ; soon extends around hips and down right leg.
Feels as if lying on a board ; changes position often, bed feels so hard ; worst part in region of sacrum. θ Typhus.
Rheumatic pains in muscles of back, followed by burning.
Pain in right subscapular muscle ; < on motion of arm ; > from pressing part against something hard ; 3d day.
Pain under right scapula ; > on motion.
Pain in sacrum. θ Typhus.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Bapt.]
Severe pain in left shoulder joint, causing a disagreeable, sickening feeling at stomach ; also darts of pains in various parts of body ; < during rest and when thinking of them.
Pain in left shoulder, extending down arm.
Feels sore and stiff about shoulders and chest.
Pain in right elbow, causing a weakness in arm and hand, scarcely able to hold pencil while noting this symptom.
Rheumatic thrusts in left ulna (lower part), with pain in different parts of body ; < at rest.
Severe rheumatic stitches in metacarpal bone of left index finger, lasting several minutes.
Rheumatic stitches in left radius, lasting but a little while.
Numbness of left hand and forearm, with prickling ; < from movement ; sharp darting pains through fingers.
Hands feel large, tremulous.
Rheumatic pains in left wrist and stitches in right eye.
Tearing pains in carpal bones of right hand, lasting but a short time, followed by several sharp pains in phalanges of left hand.
A sharp dart of pain in first phalanx while writing.
Pain running up and down bones of left forearm ; 3d day.
Tearing pain in palm of left hand, and also darts in various parts of body ; 2d day.
Terrible rheumatic pains in metacarpal bones of left hand, lasting but a few moments, though very severe ; also pain in left knee and shoulder ; 1st day.
Tearing pain in right metacarpus ; 2d day.
Rheumatic pain in metacarpal bone and phalanges of left thumb (long, severe thrusts), lasting several minutes, every thrust causes a momentary sickness at pit of stomach ; 1st day.
Sharp stitches under left thumb nail, lasting but a few moments, but returning in a short time as before ; 2d day.
Rheumatic pain in phalanges of middle finger right hand, and also in right shoulder joint ; 1st day.
Pain in metacarpal bone of right little finger ; 1st day.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Bapt.]
Lower limbs feel weak and vacillating when walking.
Soreness in anterior of thighs ; < after sitting awhile.
Drawing in hips and calves.
Several rheumatic stitches in outer hamstring.
Severe pain in left knee (outer side), running down into fibula.
Rheumatic pain in left knee joint.
Dull pain in right patella and right tarsal bones.
Cramp in calves whenever he moves them.
Pains in lower part of left ulna and tarsus.
Left foot numb, prickling.
Burning of top of right foot, from toes to back of foot.
Rheumatic pain on inner side of right os calcis ; 1st day.
Tearing pains in os calcis of right foot, lasting about half a minute ; 1st day.
Rheumatic pains in phalanges of right great toe ; 1st day.
Pain in first phalanx of right great toe, as if hair on it was steadily and continually pulled ; < at rest, > on motion ; after moving a little while toe feels hot, and then pain leaves, but when at rest heat leaves, and pains return.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Bapt.]
Rheumatic pain in right (lower part) ulna, also in muscles on posterior part of right thigh and metacarpal bones of right index finger.
Rheumatic pain in right shin bone, also in bones of left wrist and hand ; 1st day.
Aching in limbs.
Drawing in arms and legs.
Rheumatic pains in left elbow and knee, and also right ankle and heel ; 1st day.
Rheumatic stitches in right subscapular muscle, with pains in different parts of body, especially in metacarpal bones and phalanges, lasting but a few moments ; pains in hand seem to be deep in bones ; 1st day.
Aches from his finger ends to his toes.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Bapt.]
Lying quiet : pain behind ear better.
Rest : pain in left groin > ; asthma > ; darts of pain through body < ; pain in left ulna < ; pain in great toe worse.
After sitting : soreness in thighs.
Lying down : difficult breathing.
Motion : pain in forehead < ; eyeballs sore ; asthma < ; pain in left chest < ; pain under right scapula > ; cramp in calves ; pain in right great toe better.
Ascending : limbs weak ; pain in liver.
Descending : arms and calves feel sore.
On rising : faintness.
Turning over : pains in epigastrium worse.
Stooping : dizziness ; soreness anterior brain worse.
Walking : fluctuation in head ; pain in stomach and liver ; pain in left groin < ; lumbar backache < ; lower limbs weak.
   

NERVES. [36] [Bapt.]
Restlessness. θ Typhus.
Morbid irritability of nervous system, preventing sleep. θ Typhus.
Restless, uneasy, could confine himself to nothing ; wanted to be moving from place to place, evening. θ Typhus.
Dull, heavy feeling in whole body, with indifference to everything.
General malaise for several days. θ Typhus.
General weak feeling, but especially of lower limbs.
Feels weak, tremulous, as if recovering from sickness, and yet incapable of vigorous mental or physical exertion.
Entire system feels weak, especially lower limbs and knees ; vertigo.
A weak, languid feeling in body (especially arms, extending into hands and fingers), scarcely able to hold pencil while writing, causing one to feel as limber as an old rag ; perfect indifference ; no desire to do anything.
Feel weak and languid, sore and bruised, especially arms and calves of legs feel sore on going down-stairs.
Feel weak and exhausted after a little labor, soon becoming tired.
Feels weak, tremulous, as after severe sickness.
Faintness on rising. θ Typhus.
Great languor ; wants to lie down.
Lassitude and weakness of whole body, with indifference ; 3d day.
Great prostration and restlessness. θ Cough.
Prostration and trembling. θ Typhus.
Prostration. θ Diphtheria.
Disagreeable prostration, with soreness of muscles. θ Typhus.
Great prostration of strength, as during convalescence from some severe sickness, when treated by strong drugs and medicine ; 1st day.
Indescribable sick feeling all over.
Slides down in bed ; feels as if sinking away. θ Typhus.
Lay in semiconscious condition when she appeared dying. θ Typhus.
Paralysis of whole left side ; left hand and arm are numb, powerless.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Bapt.]
Excessive drowsiness.
Feels very drowsy, can hardly keep awake ; 3d day.
Drowsiness, can only keep awake by great effort ; pains in body still continue ; 1st day.
Drowsy, stupid, tired feeling ; disposition to half close eyes.
Feels dull and sleepy ; with slight headache ; 3d day.
Feels sleepy and drowsy ; lay down to doze, but soon lower limbs suddenly start as if had been frightened.
Feels drowsy ; while sitting on a chair and lying with head on arms, and arms on table (dozing, yet conscious), had a sensation as if some person touched him very gently in both sides ; followed by a want of power to sit up, made several efforts to do so, but was perfectly helpless ; in a short time had a similar attack of about same duration, but more severe ; felt weak for some time afterwards.
Delirious stupor : falls asleep while answering a question or while being talked to.
Lies semicomatose, looks as if dying. θ Typhus.
Slept well until about 3 A. M., then restless until morning, tossing about.
Restless ; does not sleep quietly.
Sleep restless, frequent wakings ; 3d day.
Wants to get up and yet does not want to. θ Typhus.
Sleepless, with wandering of mind. θ Typhus.
Delirious disturbance at night, varying from a mere uneasiness and inability to sleep to delirium proper. θ Typhus.
Cannot sleep ; head or body feels scattered about bed ; tosses about to get pieces together. θ Typhus and other diseases.
Wants to get out of bed. θ Typhus.
Restless, with frightful dreams. θ Typhus.
Sleep restless and troubled with dreams, but inability to remember what had been dreamed, and weariness, as if had not slept enough ; 2d day.
Sleep restless, troubled by vivid dreams, and also frequent wakings ; 2d day.
Sleep last night restless, tossing about, troubled with continual dreams, they continuing up to moment of awaking, yet unable to tell, or even to remember what had been dreaming of ; 3d day.
Sleep very restless, dreams ; heavy gnawing at stomach ; pains in hands ; 4th day.
Nightmare.
Sleeplessness. θ Typhus.
Worse on awaking : difficult breathing ; parts rested on feel very painful ; flashes of heat.
   

TIME. [38] [Bapt.]
At 3 A. M. : restless, tossing ; flashes of heat.
Morning : tongue brown and dry ; pain and injection of eye ; swelling of epiglottis ; chilly sitting by fire.
All day : chilliness.
Afternoon : pain in anterior brain ; weight and oppression in precordial region ; hemorrhoids < ; fever increases.
At 2 P. M. : pulse rises from 70 to 100.
At 6 P. M. : oppressed breathing.
Evening : cramp in stomach ; pulse hard ; chilly.
Night : delirium ; increased secretion of urine ; fever ; heat, burning in legs prevents sleep.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Bapt.]
Autumn or hot weather : dysentery worse.
Great aversion to open air. θ Spasmodic stricture of œsophagus.
Chilled by standing in cold wind ; fever returned, with rapid prostration. θ Typhus.
   

FEVER. [40] [Bapt.]
Shivering. θ Typhus.
Shivering preceded by a sense of weakness. θ Typhus.
Chilly all day ; whole body feels sore.
Chilly on going into open air ; chills over back and lower limbs ; evening.
Chilly over back while sitting by a fire ; forenoon.
Chilliness alternated with heat. θ Typhus.
Chilliness of lower limbs and back, with fever at night. θ Diphtheria.
Chill followed by fever, with severe aching in muscular portion of body. θ Typhus.
Whole surface hot and dry, with occasional chills, mostly up and down back.
Extremities feel hot, except feet, which are cold.
Flashes of heat from small of back in all directions ; dull, heavy aching, great prostration.
On awaking at 3 A. M., flashes of heat, feeling as if sweat would break out.
Gentle flashes of heat over whole body.
Fever set in with headache. θ Typhus.
General fever and malaise.
Heat of face, flashes over face.
Burning, pungent heat over whole body, especially in face. θ Typhus.
Heat at night ; burning in legs preventing sleep.
Heat of skin. θ Typhus.
Uncomfortable burning all over surface, especially face ; had to move to a cool part of bed, and finally to rise and open a window and wash his face and hands.
Gentle flushes of heat over whole body, followed by a slight perspiration.
Frequent sweats. θ Typhus.
Causes sweat to break out and relieves ; critical sweat on forehead and face. θ Typhus.
Fetid sweat.
Chills, fever and sweat every other afternoon.
Fever cases, with peculiar delirium ; dulness of intellect and abdominal tenderness.
Sensation as if there was a second self outside of patient. θ Typhus.
Fever, delirium, headache, pain in back and limbs ; (compare Rhus). θ Typhus.
General fever and malaise. θ Typhus.
Aspect of low fever. θ Typhus.
Determination of blood to surface and profuse sweating. θ Typhus.
Early stages : white tongue, red edges ; or brown, or yellow brown down centre ; bitter or flat taste ; cannot digest food ; stools frequent, yellow ; gurgling and slight sensitiveness of right iliac region ; pulse high ; fever tends to increase ; parts rested on are sore. θ Typhus.
Typhus and typhoid fever, with a tendency to putrescence.
Fever originating from confinement on shipboard, without good care or food.
Beginning of typhus, when so-called nervous symptoms predominate.
Cerebral forms, especially with excessive drowsiness, delirium, confusion of ideas, stupefying headache ; restless sleep, head feels scattered about ; frightful dreams ; great debility and nervous prostration, with erethism, etc.
Typhoid and cerebral forms of fever ; delirium, drowsiness, confusion, gives slow answer or falls asleep attempting a reply ; erethism ; tries to escape from bed ; sleepless because she cannot get herself together ; head feels scattered, and she tosses about to get pieces together ; sensation of a second self outside of patient ; indifferent ; low delirium, stupor ; sordes on teeth ; face dark, besotted looking ; hearing dull ; epistaxis ; involuntary, scanty stool ; difficult breathing ; fever increases each afternoon.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Bapt.]
Right : pain in temple ; pain behind ear ; pain over ear ; stitches in eye ; running from nostril ; ear sore ; nostril stopped ; pain in mastoid process ; pain in lung ; stitches in tonsil ; iliac region sensitive ; stitches in groin ; stitches in kidney ; pain under scapula ; pain down leg ; pain in elbow ; pain in eye ; pains in hand ; pain in shoulder joint ; pain in little finger ; pain in patella ; burning top of foot ; pain in os calcis ; pain in great toe.
Left : pain over eye ; pain in eye ; eye weak ; stitches in eyes ; pain in orbit ; pain below ear ; pain in parotid gland ; bleeding from nostril ; burning side of face and head ; shooting in kidney ; pain in groin ; pain in testicle ; pain through chest ; stitches in nipple ; pain in shoulder joint ; pain in ulna ; stitches in radius ; numbness of hand and forearm ; pain in waist ; pain in bones of forearm ; pains in hand ; pain in knee and shoulder ; pain in thumb ; stitches under thumb nail ; foot numb ; paralysis of whole side.
Above downward : pain in shoulder.
Below upward : heat in stomach.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Bapt.]
As if there was a second self ; as if scattered about ; as of a band around forehead ; as if temples were pressed by thumbs ; as if top of head would fly off ; as if head was swelling ; as if eyes were pressed into head, as if he had eaten pepper ; as if water had passed through posterior nares ; as of a hard substance in stomach ; as if lying on a board ; as if hair on first phalanx of right great toe was pulled.
Peculiar feeling of brain.
Sharp pain : in temples ; over eyes ; in bowels ; in left groin ; in chest ; in sternum ; in left knee.
Sharp thrusts : over right eye ; in left ulna ; in left thumb.
Darting : in body ; in carpus, metacarpus and phalanges.
Cutting : in bowels.
Hot stitches : in temples.
Stitches : in head ; in upper eyelid ; in right eye ; in left eye like needles ; in right tonsil ; in right groin ; in right kidney ; in sternum ; in left nipple ; in metacarpal bone of left index finger ; in left radius ; under left thumb nail ; in outer hamstring ; in right subscapularis muscle.
Shooting : in bowels ; in left kidney.
Pricking : in pharynx.
Prickling : of left side of face and head ; in left hand and forearm ; of left foot.
Tearing : in right metacarpus ; in right os calcis.
Drawing : in cervical muscles ; along nose ; in right groin and testicle ; in legs and knee joints ; in hips and calves ; in arms and legs.
Fiery pain : when urinating.
Burning : of eyes ; of left side of face and head ; of cheeks ; at root of tongue ; in throat ; in fauces ; in stomach ; at anus ; when urinating ; in muscles of back ; dorsum of r. foot ; in legs ; all over skin.
Soreness : in back of head ; as if in brain ; of eyeballs ; in front of head ; of right ear ; from nose to nares ; of teeth and gums ; of fauces ; of abdominal muscles ; in bowels ; of larynx ; of right lung ; down neck ; about shoulders and chest ; in anterior of thighs.
Pressure : in forehead ; at stomach ; in left testicle.
Aching : in stomach and liver ; in bowels ; in lumbar region ; of back and hips ; in limbs ; from finger ends to toes.
Bruised ache : in head ; in occiput ; in pectoralis minor.
Squeezed pain : in left testicle.
Rheumatic pain : in back ; in left wrist ; in left thumb ; in right middle finger and shoulder joint ; in left knee ; on inner side of right os calcis ; in right and left ulna ; in muscles of posterior part of right thigh ; in metacarpal bone of right index finger ; in right shin bone ; in bones of left wrist and hand ; in left elbow ; in right ankle and heel.
Cramp : at root of nose ; in stomach ; in testes ; in calves.
Colicky pains : in umbilical and hypogastric region.
Griping : in bowels.
Scraped feeling : on tongue ; in throat.
Gnawing : in stomach.
Dull pain : in anterior lobes of brain and frontal sinus ; at root of nose ; in spleen ; at pit of stomach ; in umbilical region ; in left chest ; in sacrum ; in right patella and tarsal bones.
Undefined pain : in right temple ; behind right ear ; in region of supraorbital nerve ; in limbs and small of back ; over l. eye ; below left ear ; in left parotid ; in right mastoid process ; in articulation of jaw ; in right lung ; in root of tongue ; in epigastric region ; in cardiac region of stomach ; in liver ; in gall-bladder ; in spleen ; in abdomen ; in right lung ; through left chest ; under right scapula ; in sacrum ; in l. shoulder ; down arm ; in right elbow ; in metacarpal bone of right little finger ; in lower part of left ulna and tarsus.
Throbbing : in head ; over eyes.
Beating : in forehead.
Fulness : of head ; in stomach.
Heaviness : of head ; over eyes ; in chest ; in whole body.
Weight : in precordial region ; over eyes.
Oppression : in precordial region.
Tightness : of head.
Constricted feeling : in œsophagus ; of diaphragm ; of lungs.
Bloated feeling : of eyes.
Swollen feeling : of head ; of tongue.
Large feeling : of head and hands.
Tired feeling : in neck.
Weak feeling : general ; in chest.
Weakness : in arms and hands ; of lower limbs ; in knees ; of body.
"Gone" feeling : at stomach.
Shocks : in head.
Numbness : of hand ; of face ; of tongue ; of left hand and forearm ; of left foot.
Tickling : in throat.
Heat : in ears ; in forehead ; in face ; in fauces ; in stomach ; in liver ; of the skin.
Dryness : of the skin.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Bapt.]
Prostration with disposition of fluids to decompose.
Stiffness of all joints, as though strained ; rheumatic pains and soreness all over body.
Discharges and exhalations fetid ; breath, stools, urine, sweat, ulcers.
Ulceration of mucous membranes, especially those of mouth ; also with tendency to putrescence.
Enlarged glands.
Diseases of mucous membranes.
Derangements of mucous surfaces, generally with vomiting and purging.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Bapt.]
Touch : larynx sore.
Pressure : abdominal muscles sore ; headache > ; pain in mastoid region > ; pain region of supraorbital nerve > ; pain left orbit >.
Pressing on crown of head : pain in left eye <.
   

SKIN. [46] [Bapt.]
Burning all over skin, < in face.
Livid spots over body and limbs, not elevated, of irregular shape, size of a pea up to bean, without any sensation.
Rose-colored spots on 9th day. θ Typhus.
Eruption like measles or urticaria.
Pimples thick on palatine arch, tonsils and uvula ; breath fetid ; salivation ; prostration. θ Variola.
Foul, gangrenous, phagedenic syphilitic sores.
Smallpox confluent, tardy eruption.
Gangrenous sores, aphthæ, sore nipples (locally).
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Bapt.]
Lymphatic temperament.
Children : offensive diarrhœa.
Old people : dysentery.
Girl, æt. 7, after being physicked, etc., for a cough ; great prostration, etc.
Old woman, æt. 79 ; Üdema.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Bapt.]
Cognates : Arnic., Arsen., Bryon., Gelsem., (especially in the malaise, nervousness, flushed face or drowsiness, and muscular soreness in early stages) ; Hyosc., Kali chlor., Laches., Mur. ac., Nitr. ac. (in typhoids) ; Nux vom., Opium, Rhus tox.
When. Arsen. has been given in typhus improperly.
Silic., like Baptis., has ability to swallow only liquids, (like milk), but unlike the latter, it has also aversion to milk. See 13.
Terebinth. and Nitr. ac. acted well after Baptis. θ Typhus.
Hamam. speedily checked copious, repeated epistaxis. θ Typhus.
